_comment: Single source of truth for the classification rules. Must match Table 6 of the manuscript exactly. Lengths and widths in metres; elongation is length over mean width, dimensionless.
_width_bias_note: Predicted masks are about 19 percent wider than hand-annotated masks at the median over 1,605 matched objects. Applied to classification only, never to reported volumes.

floors._width_m_note: Three pixels at the stated GSD.

_test_order_note: Definitional. Reversing width and length changes the split between the two exclusion categories.
